description:
Follow entity relationships to retrieve related records in a single call.

Uses navigation properties defined in the entity schema to traverse relationships.
Use describe_entity first to see available navigation properties for an entity.

Examples:
- Get order lines for an order: entity="SalesOrderHeaders", key="SO-001", relationship="SalesOrderLines"
- With compound key: entity="SalesOrderHeaders", key={"DataAreaId": "usmf", "SalesOrderNumber": "SO-001"}, relationship="SalesOrderLines"
- With field selection: relationship="SalesOrderLines", select=["ItemNumber", "LineAmount", "Quantity"]
- With filter: relationship="SalesOrderLines", filter="LineAmount gt 1000"
- Limit results: relationship="SalesOrderLines", top=10

environment.description: Target D365 environment name. If omitted, uses the environment set via 'set_environment' tool, or falls back to the default environment. Use list_environments to see available environments.

fetchAll.description: Automatically fetch all pages of related records (default: false)

filter.description: OData $filter to apply to related records (e.g., 'LineAmount gt 1000')

key.description: Primary key of source record. String for simple keys ('SO-001'), object for compound keys ({DataAreaId: 'usmf', SalesOrderNumber: 'SO-001'})

relationship.description: Navigation property name to follow (e.g., 'SalesOrderLines'). Use describe_entity to see available relationships.

select.description: Fields to include from related entity. Omit to include all fields.

top.description: Maximum related records to return per page (default: 1000)

name: get_related
